description: Approved next scoped refactor. Reuse ChannelConfig schema/table/query contracts in Engine; merge scope/revision/archive persistence into existing Engine.ConnectorLifecycle and reuse ArchiveChannelConnector Action/Zoi. Channels keeps confidential supplied-config teardown and runtime stages only, no Repo or BO actor reload in archive path. Move pure SMTP settings helper to neutral namespace; extract pure IMAP settings access shared with Engine while bridge/listener normalization stays Channels. Update schema references and regressions without claiming remaining legacy Channels DB consumers isolated. Tests first archive ordering, stale revisions, retries, no Repo in runtime leaf; affected suites+mix q. Preserve user staging, no commit/push. Action reuse: extend existing archive command, local-only pure parsing/schema CRUD internals, no new tool exposure.

comments.text: Implemented approved scoped ownership move, uncommitted. Engine.ChannelConfig now owns unchanged Ecto table/query/encryption/default contracts; all code/schema references updated, no data migration. Engine.ConnectorLifecycle now owns context/3, scope/revision checks, watch ordering and locked archive persistence. Confidential Channels connector_teardown_ingress(config) and connector_sync_runtime(before/after maps) delegate only provider stages to new ConnectorRuntime, with no Repo/current BO lookup. Added supplied-config overload for ingress deletion (exact selected connector), retained legacy provider-only path outside scope. Archive stop retries intentionally remain effective for already-disabled persisted rows. Pure SMTP/IMAP lookup and settings projections moved/extracted to Zaq.ConnectorConfig; Channels mailbox/listener normalization remains local, Engine no longer imports it. Existing archive/save Actions and Zoi preserved; no new Action/tool exposure. Migrated archive tests and added revision-race, sibling/secret-free outcomes, Repo-free real email runtime retry and lookup property tests. Final affected PASS2025 tests/24properties. mix q PASS +S1:1 after alias/nesting fixes, no exclusion/config weakening. Existing browser runs:61/64 then3/3 failed-case rerun; repeat63/64 then1/1 rerun. Readiness/dialog timeouts intermittent, stable combined browser gate not established; no assertions changed. First broad regression exposed provider mismatch error contract; restored connector_not_found instead of weakening test. Authoritative service docs/handoff updated; old source/event reference audit and whitespace clean. Review/coverage/final precommit remain pending. No staging/index/commit/push actions; user work retained.

Approved follow-up fixes archive runtime reconciliation: reuse existing Bridge stop_runtime/1 callback via configured bridge resolution, not generic sync_config_runtime or fabricated enabled=true state. Preserve confidential supplied-config event and exact connector validation; internal stage of existing Archive Action, no new Action/behaviour. Tests first real JidoChatBridge webhook path with transport/runtime collaborators only, initial delete once, retry zero deletes, stop failures truthful pending, missing runtime idempotent and sibling isolation/Repo-free application. Correct stale handoff. Focused lifecycle/bridge/email/data-source suites and mix q; final review/coverage/precommit and Git authorization remain pending.

Quality gate exposed duplicate positive-ID parsing already introduced by the ownership move. Bounded fix reuses existing ParseUtils.parse_int_strict/1 plus positive-value check in Engine.ConnectorLifecycle (local-only scope parsing, not a new operation/Action); exact integer/string/no-trailing-data contracts unchanged. Also correcting prior alias-order findings; no unrelated logic refactor.

Archive reconciliation finding FIXED in working tree. ConnectorRuntime resolves configured bridge and calls existing stop_runtime/1 directly; synthetic enabled=true and generic update callback removed. Runtime event shape/exact identity validation unchanged; collaborator runtime overrides now implement stop_runtime/1. Regression first red: real Jido initial archive and retry returned ingress_teardown_failed/already_deleted. Final green: 533tests+2properties, mix q (+S1:1) clean, whitespace clean. Real Engine/Jido tests use adapter transport and supervisor collaborators, prove delete once, sibling runtime preserved, persisted archive with truthful pending stop failure, retry no deletion, ordinary disable still tears down ingress. Separate Channels ExUnit (not DataCase, no Sandbox owner/persisted connector) runs real Jido stop/retry with adapter methods that raise on any provider webhook IO. Removed misleading Task-in-shared-DataCase no-ownership test in favor of actual standalone fixture. Prior positive-ID parser duplication corrected via ParseUtils.parse_int_strict preserving exact-positive ID contract and adding malformed-ID regression; prior alias ordering corrected, no check exclusions. Updated authoritative Channels docs and stale handoff paragraph/latest results. No new feature UI/E2E tests, no staging/index/commit/push. Existing browser flakiness, review/coverage/final precommit and authorized landing remain pending; HEAD f634e990cc91f2974c7fda54ace5bb3958a56d63.
